title: Making water safe to drink
caption: River or reservoir water is screened to remove large debris, treated with a coagulant (aluminium or iron(III) sulfate) so fine particles clump and settle, filtered through sand, and finally chlorinated to kill microorganisms.
alt: A flow: screening → coagulation and sedimentation → sand filtration → chlorination → drinking water.
description: Coagulation and sedimentation: small particles clump and settle.
